blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse applied to Workforce & Vocational Training. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Corporate learning and vocational systems are judged on capability transfer: skills taxonomy, personalized pathways, credential portability and employer verification. The systems that prove skill deltas win the budget conversation.

items: HRIS, LMS and performance data siloed; skills picture guessed.
Training content one-size; engagement and transfer low.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Master Data, Governance & Cataloging, Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics, Data Monetization & Analytics Products from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Skills taxonomy management, Pathway personalization, Assessment/verification) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — Privacy among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Lakehouse the right way: Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Decisions at event speed: sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Metrics into management: one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.
HRIS/LMS/performance unified to skills graph (gaps visible)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: SIS/LMS/support data unified with outcome lineage (intervention targeting measurable). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
